summary: Lists DevOps and app integration device_type values (ci_cd_platform, container_registry, message_queue, api_endpoint) and says to propose new types on the Ansible forum.
questions: What device_type do I use for a container registry?
What if my resource doesn't match any taxonomy type?

answer_card.title: DevOps and integration device types
answer_card.answer_md:
- CI/CD platforms: `ci_cd_platform`
- Container registries: `container_registry`
- Message queues: `message_queue`
- API endpoints: `api_endpoint`

If nothing fits, propose a new device type on the Ansible forum.
